description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named NotesController, which provides CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) endpoints for managing notes in a web application. It maps HTTP requests to service calls related to note operations.

classes.name: NotesController
classes.description: A REST controller exposing CRUD endpoints for notes, utilizing Spring MVC annotations, Swagger documentation annotations, and interacting with a NoteService for business logic.

methods.name: listNotes
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of all notes.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific note by its ID.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new note, expects a request body with note details.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing note identified by ID.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a note by its ID.
